alex (support): Heads-up — Acme just escalated. After last night's traffic-shift rollout they see misrouted/missing tool calls during checkout. They say prices are blank or wrong. Ticket INC-5621 and sample below.
priya (cs): Customer pasted the failing example. They hit our /v1/chat with a small convo and expected a single tool call `price_lookup`, but model either called `inventory_check` or no tool at all.
alex (support): Example request they sent:
```json
POST /v1/chat
{
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"What is the price for product 01234?"}],
  "tools": ["price_lookup","inventory_check","tax_calc"],
  "model": "redwood-chat-3b",
  "route": "checkout-pricing"
}
```
Expected tool invocation (from their usage logs):
```
CALL price_lookup args={"product_id":"01234","currency":"USD"}
```
Actual tool shown in their logs:
```
CALL inventory_check args={"sku":"01234"}
OR
NO TOOL CALL (model returned plain text: "Price unavailable")
```
tara (eng-runtime): :eyes: I'm looking into the router mapping that was part of the traffic-shift rollout (PR #4321). There was a change in how we serialize the api->tool binding table when we do the canary flip. Can you attach the customer's full request ID or event_id? log-collector, can you pull router logs for route=checkout-pricing between 2024-10-05T22:50 and 2024-10-05T23:10 UTC?

log-collector: pulled logs for that window. Sample router trace:
```
2024-10-05T22:56:12Z router TRACE req=rb-abc123 route=checkout-pricing selected_toolchain=[tax_calc, inventory_check, price_lookup]
2024-10-05T22:56:12Z model INVOKE rb-abc123 output="CALL inventory_check args={'sku':'01234'}"
```
Note: ordering in `selected_toolchain` looks rotated compared to config.
devin (eng-ml): This smells like the dict/ordering bug we fixed in runtime v3.2.3 but maybe the fix didn't deploy to the router side. The code path that builds the toolmap uses `yaml.safe_dump(dict)` which can produce non-deterministic key order in Py<3.11 when combined with C extensions. If the model picks the first matching tool by index, a rotated list will cause the wrong tool to be chosen.
mike (sre): I can repro quickly in a staging job. Steps I'm using:
1) spin up router v3.2.4-canary with same config
2) curl POST to /v1/chat with same body and log the `selected_toolchain` in router traces
3) compare to baseline v3.2.2
alex (support): Customer asked for a workaround — they can pin to an older model/route if possible. Priya, can we offer temporary mitigation?

priya (cs): Offered customer a short-term workaround: force `tools` order in the client and set `tool_precedence=explicit` on requests (if they can change client). They acknowledged and will try, but they want platform fix asap.
tara (eng-runtime): Action plan:
- Roll back canary to v3.2.2 for traffic-shift (hot rollback) — reduces blast radius. (ETA 20m) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
- Patch router code to use stable ordering when serializing tool maps (explicit sort by tool name) and add unit test.
- Add integration test that runs >100 random permutations to catch ordering nondeterminism.
deploy-bot: initiated rollback: router group "traffic-shift" -> version v3.2.2 at 2024-10-05T23:08:14Z
tara (eng-runtime): Confirmed rollback complete. Can anyone verify with their logs that `selected_toolchain` is now stable?

log-collector: post-rollback sample:
```
2024-10-05T23:09:02Z router TRACE req=rb-abc124 route=checkout-pricing selected_toolchain=[price_lookup, inventory_check, tax_calc]
2024-10-05T23:09:02Z model INVOKE rb-abc124 output="CALL price_lookup args={'product_id':'01234','currency':'USD'}"
```
alex (support): Told customer we rolled back and are pushing a code fix. They will retest and report. :thumbsup:
devin (eng-ml): I'll open PR to force stable serialization + add integration fuzz test. Assigning to tara for review.
priya (cs): Customer says they're seeing partial recovery; some checkouts now show price again. Keeping ticket open until they confirm full resolution.
mike (sre): Postmortem note: add a canary test that validates tool ordering invariants before shifting 100% traffic.
alex (support): Great work team. I'll update INC-5621 with the rollback timeline, links to logs, and next steps. Closing thread once customer confirms full recovery. :white_check_mark:
